Glossary

Glossary of queue terms

The glossary lists the terms used by the crawler and by the queue that feeds it.

shard
A unit of work that one worker claims at a time.
lease
A time-bounded claim on a shard.
renewal
Extending an unexpired lease before it lapses.
expiry
The moment a lease stops being valid and the shard returns to the queue.
queue depth
The number of shards waiting to be claimed.
straggler
A shard that takes much longer than its neighbours and holds up the end of the run.

A term that is missing here is probably documented next to the code that uses it.
